rows.label: qst202201_msg004
rows.name:
I know. It crackles even when
you're just nearby...

rows.label: qst202201_msg006
rows.name:
I'm always giving it my
all, so my power's like,
always overflowing too.

rows.label: qst202201_msg007
rows.name:
It uh...it doesn't
bug you or anything?

rows.label: qst202201_msg008
rows.name:
If I touch Raiko, I get zapped,
so yeah, it does bother me a little...

rows.label: qst202201_msg009
rows.name:
But it's not really that much
of a deal, I don't think.

rows.label: qst202201_msg010
rows.name:
But I can only ever go full power,
and I can barely control it, you know?

rows.label: qst202201_msg011
rows.name:
I wish I could use my power as well
as Homura-san does...

rows.label: qst202201_msg012
rows.name:
That's not true. Raiko-chan,
I think you're plenty charming
just the way you are...

rows.label: qst202201_msg013
rows.name:
Yeah! Everything's a whole lot
brighter when you're around, Raiko!

rows.label: qst202201_msg014
rows.name:
Isn't that just because my lightning's
illuminating the place...?

rows.label: qst202201_msg015
rows.name:
That's not true. You're like
a cute younger sister to us,
and you help soothe us.

rows.label: qst202201_msg017
rows.name:
I wonder if it's okay for me
to stay like this...

rows.label: qst202201_msg018
rows.name:
It feels like I'm only useful
in battle...
